# rev6 (EXP-687, curmudgeon cycle-5 C5-1). NOT PRE-REGISTERED. Derived from rev5_dr1_unified.py (rev5 bundle); every fit, null and
# injection is unchanged. C5-1 fix, option (i): ONE function, dr1_label(), now scores BOTH the PRED-095 card and our B1-M-001 band:
#   testable  = 3-sigma injection power >= 0.8 at the registration's most testable claimed amplitude, in EVERY admitted variant
#               (card: -17.8 nT; our band: its floor -25 nT, the most negative and so most testable point);
#   consistent surviving detection = CTL-1-surviving detection with a <= band_upper + 2 x null_sd (same +2 SD margin on both sides);
#   label     = NOT FALSIFIED if any consistent surviving detection; else FALSIFIED as-if if testable; else UNTESTED.
# For our band the falsified portion is reported as [-25, a80], a80 = least negative amplitude whose 3-sigma injection power is >= 0.8
# in every admitted variant (grid -5..-40 nT, 0.25 nT steps, same devs loop as the power columns).
# (rev5 header kept below) rev5 (EXP-687, curmudgeon cycle-4 C4-1 + HNOTE-ANALYST-EXP687-REV5-DECISION5-2026-10-04). NOT PRE-REGISTERED.
# ONE DR-1 standard for both sides (curmudgeon recommendation (i)): eclipse-attributable joint-fit amplitude a = A - null_mean on the
# component each registration names (H for the PRED-095 card and for our B1-M-001 band), DETECTION standard (a <= -3 x null_sd),
# CTL-1 discount (the same template and window fitted to non-eclipsed ASC/KOU/HER; a station detection is discounted when any control
# reproduces it at similar z, operationalised as control z <= 0.75 x station z), and each registration restricted to the lags its own
# text admits: card 'during eclipse totality' -> tau 0-15 (tau 30 reported as sensitivity); our band, frozen +/-60 min window -> tau 0-60.
# A claim is FALSIFIED as-if when it is testable (3-sigma injection power >= 0.8 at the claimed amplitude) and no CTL-1-surviving
# detection consistent with it is observed. Same null convention as rev3_fits.py (Kp(12-24 UT)<=3 control days, leave-one-out baseline).

from rev3_fits import jfit

ST=['EBR','SPT','HAD','CLF','NGK','ESK','LER']; CTL=['ASC','KOU','HER']; TAUS=[0,15,30,60]
GRID=[round(-5-0.25*i,2) for i in range(141)]
def fits(s,comp,series):
    d=load(series); c1,tm,c4=contacts(s); ob=obsc_series(s); w=np.arange(c1-60,c4+61); out={}
    for t in TAUS:
        tp=lag(ob,t); tp=tp/tp.max()
        for quad in (False,True):
            ev=None; nul=[]; devs=[]
            for day in sorted(d):
                b,_=base(d,comp,Q,exclude=day); x=d[day][comp]-b; a=jfit(x,w,tp,quad)
                if not np.isfinite(a): continue
                if day==EVD: ev=a
                elif max(KPD[day][4:8])<=3.0: nul.append(a); devs.append(x)
            if ev is None or len(nul)<8: continue
            nul=np.array(nul); mu,sd=float(nul.mean()),float(nul.std(ddof=1))
            rec=dict(A_raw=round(ev,2),null_mean=round(mu,2),null_sd=round(sd,2),eclipse_attributable=round(ev-mu,2),z=round((ev-mu)/sd,2),n_null=len(nul),
                     threshold_3sigma_eclipse_attributable=round(-3*sd,2))
            if series==s:
                pw={}
                for an,av in [('card_-17.8',CARD),('card_arith_-17.43',CARD_ARITH),('our_band_-5',-5.0),('our_band_-25',-25.0)]:
                    f=np.array([jfit(x+av*tp,w,tp,quad) for x in devs]); pw[an]=round(float(np.mean(f<mu-3*sd)),2)
                rec['power_3sigma']=pw
                g={}
                for av in GRID:
                    f=np.array([jfit(x+av*tp,w,tp,quad) for x in devs]); g[av]=float(np.mean(f<mu-3*sd))
                ok=[av for av in GRID if all(g[b]>=0.8 for b in GRID if b<=av)]
                rec['a80_nT']=max(ok) if ok else None
            out[f"tau{t}|{'quad' if quad else 'lin'}"]=rec
    return out
